methodNote.G4K_BOOKING.en: Book online at g4k.go.kr, then go to the consulate in person. No one can apply for you.

why.EVISA_TIER.en: {{university}} is certified for the e-visa, so the university applies for it for you. You don't need to visit the embassy.

why.CCVI_POSSIBLE.en: Your university may also apply for a Certificate of Confirmation of Visa Issuance (CCVI) for you. Your counselor tells you if it will.

why.rule.en: Apply where you live (or where you last studied), and only through the embassy's official channels.

caveat.LEGALIZATION_UNCLEAR.en: The embassy's list and the national visa manual differ on how your school documents must be authenticated: a translated copy or consular legalization. Your counselor confirms which one you need.

caveat.APOSTILLE_TRANSITION.en: Viet Nam started issuing apostilles on 11 Sep 2026, but the embassy's student visa lists still describe consular legalization. Your counselor confirms which one is accepted.

caveat.DIPLOMA_APOSTILLE_POSTS.en: The two offices differ. Astana requires an apostille on the diploma; Almaty says it is not mandatory. Your counselor confirms what your office needs.

caveat.APOSTILLE_WORDING_POSTS.en: The Mumbai checklist doesn't mention the apostille that Delhi and Chennai ask for. Your counselor confirms.

caveat.AMOUNTS_CONFLICT.en: Two official pages give different amounts for proof of funds. Your counselor confirms the current one.

caveat.TB_VALIDITY_CONFLICT.en: Official pages disagree on how long the TB certificate is valid (3 or 6 months). We use the stricter 3 months.

caveat.FEE_TIME_CONFLICT.en: Official pages disagree on the fee and processing time. Your counselor confirms them.

caveat.POST_SPLIT_UNVERIFIED.en: We couldn't confirm which regions the Manila and Cebu offices each cover. Your counselor tells you where to apply.

caveat.STALE_LIST.en: The embassy's document list is from 2019. Your counselor checks that it is still current.

caveat.FEE_EXEMPTION_UNCHECKED.en: We still need to check whether Thai nationals pay the visa fee. Your counselor confirms.

caveat.FUNDS_PERIOD_CONFLICT.en: The embassy and the national manual differ on how many months of funds language students must show. Your counselor confirms.

caveat.FEES_MISSING.en: The embassy doesn't publish the fee or processing time. Your counselor confirms them.

caveat.EVISA_TIER_UNKNOWN.en: If {{university}} holds the government's 'excellent' certification (or 'certified' for master's and doctoral study), the university can apply for an e-visa for you instead. We haven't confirmed its level. Your counselor checks.

caveat.CCVI_TIER_UNKNOWN.en: Depending on {{university}}'s certification level, the university may first need to apply for a Certificate of Confirmation of Visa Issuance (CCVI). Your counselor checks.

caveat.STALE_VERIFICATION.en: These rules were last checked on {{date}}. Your counselor checks them again before you apply.

caveat.POST_UNRESOLVED.en: We couldn't confirm which embassy or consulate covers your area. Your counselor tells you where to apply.

v20.city.Seoul.body.en:
Seoul puts about a quarter of the country's population into one metropolitan area, and most of its best-known universities into a handful of neighbourhoods: Sinchon, Anam, Gwanak and Heukseok. The subway runs until roughly midnight and a student fare across the city is about 1,500 won, so where you live and where you study do not have to be the same district.
It is the most expensive place in Korea to rent and the easiest to find part-time work, English-language services, and other people from your own country.

v20.city.Incheon.body.en:
Incheon is where you will land. It is also a university city in its own right: Songdo International Business District was built from reclaimed land in the last twenty years and now holds several campuses, including the Korean branches of foreign universities.
The airport railway puts central Seoul within an hour, and Incheon's old quarter (Chinatown, the port, Wolmido) feels like a different city from the new district.

v20.city.Ulsan.body.en:
Ulsan has the highest average income of any Korean city, and the reason is easy to see: the world's largest shipyard, a Hyundai car plant that is a district on its own, and a petrochemical complex along the coast. Engineering graduates are hired here.
It is a small city by Korean standards, half an hour from Busan, with whale-watching, a long beach and the Taehwa river running through the centre.

v20.city.Chungnam.body.en:
South Chungcheong runs from the west coast inland, and its university towns, Cheonan and Asan, are on the Seoul metro's line 1 as well as the KTX. That combination of capital-region access and provincial rent is why several large universities built campuses here.
Gongju and Buyeo, the old Baekje capitals, are in the same province and worth the afternoon.
